entities.summary: The Palatinate, or the Rhenish Palatinate (Rheinpfalz), is a historical region of Germany. The Palatinate occupies most of the southern quarter of the German state of Rhineland-Palatinate (Rheinland-Pfalz), covering an area of 5450 km2 with about 1.4 million inhabitants. Its residents are known as Palatines (Pfälzer).
